sources.title: DLMF 18.5.10, Gegenbauer finite series
sources.reading: DLMF 18.5.10 finite sum directly inspected on 2026-09-14. Exact substitution lambda=2 gives C3=32x^3-12x and C5=192x^5-160x^3+24x. Thus p3=C3/32 and p5=C5/192; both polynomial families are established.
sources.relevance: Hidden cubic and any higher polynomial direction may be normalized classical Gegenbauer polynomials. Their names/coefficients must not be advertised as newly invented polynomial families.
